verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents audio recording, transcript collection, and latency metrics. These are developer building blocks for capturing call data, not an AI that automatically reviews calls. Pipecat Evals runs scripted, developer-described conversations against the agent to check expected behavior, which is pre-deployment testing rather than automatic scoring, failure flagging, or resolution analysis of real calls. No documented post-call AI review capability appears in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
